verdict.rationale: Docs claim the SDK exposes the 'same tools, agent loop, and context management' that power Claude Code, including built-in tools, hooks, subagents, MCP, permissions, sessions, custom tools, structured outputs, and streaming — effectively mirroring UI/CLI capabilities programmatically. However, community reports describe the default SDK harness as lacking observability and extensibility compared to UI-based tools (e.g., Zed's ACP integration), and note billing/subscription restrictions that limit parity in practice for third-party apps using the SDK. missing for 10: independent verification that every UI-exposed feature (e.g., rich tool-call visualization, session management UX) is fully replicable via API without extra tooling, and resolution of community-reported harness/DX gaps.
